note: Plain's plan fitted to each army (tools/build_pack.py SCRIPT): the centre brigade advances on the village by the post road and holds it, the brigades beside it and the second line follow it up, the horse covers the flanks, the reserve stays behind and the grenadiers go up to the village at noon. For `script` players, whose orders Jev translates: stub-mode Jev reads every order as its first option, so a stub game of scripts checks plumbing only; stub self-play uses the doctrine bot (design-notes.md).
